label: Pointed Fly
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Real photograph of grey glen-check trousers laid on concrete with the waistband opened out, showing the white waistband curtain/lining, the inside of the fly, and a fly-guard tab with buttons. It is genuinely the right garment region (top of fly where it meets the waistband) and there is a tab whose tip reads as angled rather than square, but the fly is folded open and shadowed, so I cannot state that the fly placket top is finished as a true tailored point rather than a plain fly guard or a pointed waistband extension.
